itens.titulo: Can Ethereum Close the Week Above $2,672? This Level Opens the Door to $3,000
itens.descricao: Can Ethereum Close the Week Above $2,672? This Level Opens the Door to $3,000 Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read -       Ethereum trades at $2,630, just $42 below the $2,672 Fibonacci level that must hold on a weekly close to unlock the zone between $2,950 and $3,000.
-       Benzinga flagged $2,672 as the trigger level, drawn from ETH's October 2025 top to its January 2026 low, with weekly closes filtering out noise better than daily wicks.
-       ETH probably won't clear $2,672 this weekend, as thin Sunday volume and a stalled intraweek high of $2,647 leave buyers short on momentum.
As of September 19, 2026, Ethereum (CRYPTO: ETH) is trading at $2,629.80, sitting $42 beneath the pivotal $2,672 mark.
With the weekly candle set to close on September 20, traders are closely monitoring this threshold.
This line comes from a Fibonacci retracement of Ethereum's decline from its October 2025 peak to its January 2026 trough.
A weekly close above $2,672 would target the $2,950 to $3,000 range as the next major resistance.
On September 19, ETH closed at $2,619.71, following a recent high of $2,646.55, reflecting a 1.6% proximity to the $2,672 line over the past two days without breaching it.

itens.titulo: Bitcoin Is 11 Days From Its First Winning Quarter in a Year. What Needs to Hold Until September 30?
itens.descricao: Bitcoin Is 11 Days From Its First Winning Quarter in a Year. What Needs to Hold Until September 30? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read -       Bitcoin needs just 11 days of holding above $58,524 to snap a four-quarter losing streak, protected by a $22,000 cushion the August rally built.
-       The VIX at 15 signals low stress, but its March spike to 31 shows how quickly a broad-market shock could threaten the quarter close.
-       A green Q3 still leaves Bitcoin down 7% for the year, as recovering to its $87,498 December 31 starting price requires another rally leg entirely.
Bitcoin (CRYPTO:BTC) closed the second quarter of 2026 at $58,524 on June 30 and has since surged to $81,214 as of September 19, marking a remarkable 39% increase.
To achieve its first green quarter in a year, the Bitcoin price must close above its June 30 position on September 30.
The last instance of Bitcoin finishing a quarter with a positive return was in Q3 of 2025.
After peaking at an all-time high of $126,198 on October 6, 2025, Bitcoin has trended downward for three consecutive quarters, making this quarter's close particularly critical for holders.
Despite its recent gains, Bitcoin remains in negative territory overall for the year, down 7.18% from its $87,498 close on December 31, 2025.

itens.titulo: Bitcoin ETFs Now Own 6.29% of Every Bitcoin. What Happens When They Hit 10%?
itens.descricao: Bitcoin ETFs Now Own 6.29% of Every Bitcoin. What Happens When They Hit 10%? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read -       Four Bitcoin ETFs experienced losses in the week ending September 18, with the ARK 21Shares Bitcoin ETF leading at $141.9 million.
-       The funds have accumulated $55.161 billion in net inflows over 32 months, averaging roughly $1.71 billion per month.
At this rate, achieving an additional $60.5 billion will take about three years, targeting around mid-2029.
-       Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs together hold $68.4 billion in committed capital across two product lines that did not exist three years ago.
As of September 18, 2026, spot Bitcoin ETFs in the US managed $102.532 billion in assets, equating to 6.29% of the total market capitalization of Bitcoin (CRYPTO:BTC).
To reach 10%, these ETFs would need to increase their holdings by $60.5 billion, bringing the total to $163.0 billion.
What 6.29% of Bitcoin Actually Looks Like With $102.532 billion representing 6.29% of Bitcoin, Bitcoin's implied market capitalization stands at about $1.630 trillion.
Since their launch, Bitcoin ETFs have attracted $55.161 billion in net inflows, while Ethereum ETFs have garnered an additional $13.250 billion, totaling $68.4 billion across two new product lines.

itens.titulo: Solana ETFs Experience 12 Consecutive Weeks of Inflows, While Bitcoin Has Its Quietest Week on Record
itens.descricao: Solana ETFs Experience 12 Consecutive Weeks of Inflows, While Bitcoin Has Its Quietest Week on Record Yahoo Finance
trechos: Solana ETFs Experience 12 Consecutive Weeks of Inflows, While Bitcoin Has Its Quietest Week on Record Quick Read -       Spot Solana ETFs logged 12 straight weeks of inflows, with BSOL alone attracting $48M in a single Friday session despite a Fed rate hike.
-       FBTC pulled in $311M and IBIT added $108M on Friday, rescuing Bitcoin ETFs from a red week that churned $1.5B gross.
-       Solana's funds saw inflows on both September 15 and September 16, coinciding with the Senate's rejection of the CLARITY Act and the Federal Reserve's decision to raise interest rates.
-       The Bitwise Solana Staking ETF is the only Solana fund with disclosed inflows for the week, and its shares closed 12.12% higher, ahead of SOL's own 11.29% gain.
Solana (CRYPTO:SOL) spot ETFs recorded an additional $13.2 million in inflows during the week ending September 18, 2026, according to SoSoValue.
In contrast, Bitcoin (CRYPTO:BTC) spot ETFs netted only $6.2 million over the same period, reflecting the smallest weekly inflow figure in the funds' 141 weeks of trading.
The 141-week timeline includes every week since Bitcoin spot ETFs launched on January 11, 2024.
On September 14, Solana gained $11.01 million.
